initialExam.title: RBI Assistant 2026
initialExam.description: RBI Assistant recruitment for clerical cadre positions in Reserve Bank of India offices across India. Mains exam conducted June 7, 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: English (30Q), Numerical (35Q), Reasoning (35Q). Mains: English (40Q), Quant (40Q), Reasoning (40Q), GK (40Q), Computer (40Q).
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 100 questions, 100 marks, 1 hour. Mains: 200 questions, 200 marks, 2 hours + Language Proficiency Test.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Prelims → Mains → Language Proficiency Test → Provisional Allotment
initialExam.jobRole: Assistant in Reserve Bank of India offices
initialExam.careerGrowth: Assistant → Grade A Officer → Grade B Officer through promotions.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit opportunities.rbi.org.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Pension, LFC, Transport allowance
